title: CIB contamination in Galactic extinction maps
author: Cail Daley
description: TR1 galaxy clustering, shear and CMB lensing crossed with the VMPZ systematics templates in Cycle 1 and Cycle 2; the extinction template carries LSS through the CIB, and what that means for dust maps in galaxy-clustering weights.
footer: Cail Daley · GC-8 · systematics cross-correlations · October 2026

sections.title: Template fidelity
sections.outline: The VMPZ map, its tracer crosses, the Cycle-1 window, the CIB route and alternative dust maps.

sections.title: Backup
sections.outline: The CSFD caveat and how DES, DESI and Chiang & Ménard screened dust maps.
